newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late palm olein stable in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late palm olein stable in quiet trade.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were generally stable in late trading on Wednesday after early falls on weak demand and intervention selling by the state logistics bureau BULOG, traders said.
They said olein was quoted at 1,435-40 rupiah/kg in Jakarta. Crude palm oil was done at 1,250 rupiah/kg at a 500-tonne tender in Medan on Tuesday, against 1,255 rupiah previously.
"The market is being squeezed by BULOG's market operations," one trader said. "BULOG is selling at 1,435 rupiah."
Refiners said there was no margin in palm olein because of the relatively high crude palm oil prices.
"Refiners will lose money if they sell olein at 1,435 rupiah," one refiner said. "Those who get government allocations can sell at that price, but what about the others."
The state-run Joint Marketing Board allocates unspecified amounts of crude palm oil to selected refiners at below the market price for processing into olein for the local market.

Traders said buying interest was generally thin because of the Moslem Ramadan fasting month, but expected demand to pick up next week as Eid al-Fitr on February 9, the culmination of the fasting month, draws closer.
